title: FastAPI lifespan creates background tasks without cancel and await on shutdown
description: Background tasks started with asyncio.create_task in a FastAPI lifespan function must be cancelled and awaited during shutdown. Missing cancellation frequently surfaces as CancelledError traceback noise and leaves nondeterministic cleanup.
detection_method: Regex scan for asyncio.create_task usage in lifespan blocks without cancel/gather cleanup
preventionRule: In lifespan finally blocks, cancel all created tasks and await them with asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True).
remedy: Store each created task in a variable, cancel in finally, then await gather with return_exceptions=True before exit.
